- **Red Flags:** Police report was filed 3 days after the incident on 2026-10-31, creating a delay between discovery and reporting that should be explained

- **Suggested Next Step:** Standard handling tier; verify police report details, confirm repair estimate with preferred shop, and obtain statement from insured regarding the reporting delay
